name: Shanmuga Santhosh
heroTagline: Festivals, faith, and everyday emotion across India — carried home in frames and film.
docDescription: A long-form documentary following the ghats of Varanasi at first light — the rituals, the boatmen, the mourners and the priests — told through the people the city rarely lets a camera close to.
statementText: I don't chase the postcard shot — I wait for the moment right after it, when the ritual is over and the people are still standing there, being human.
galleriesNote: A running archive of festivals and quiet, unnamed moments — sorted the way a field notebook would.
aboutIntro: I go where the festival crowd thins out — that's usually where the real story is standing quietly to one side.
aboutBody: By day I work in automotive market research; the rest of my time goes to a camera bag and a notebook. My work follows human emotion through cultural festivals and everyday ritual across India — Kashi's ghats, Gudi Padwa in Mumbai, the deserts of Rajasthan — shot, cut, and voiced myself.
